description: This Java class 'ConfigDefinition' handles configuration file processing, including reading, parsing, and generating code templates for engine configuration structures, as well as managing external file references and code generation logic.

classes.name: ConfigDefinition
classes.description: Main class for processing configuration files, generating code, and managing configuration structures.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for processing configuration files, generating headers, and templates.

methods.name: processTextTemplate
methods.description: Reads a template file, applies variable substitutions, and writes the output.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads and processes each line of the configuration input file, handling structures, definitions, and custom lines.

methods.name: handleCustomLine
methods.description: Processes custom configuration lines and updates the state with custom sizes and lines.

methods.name: startsWithToken
methods.description: Checks if a line starts with a specific token followed by space or tab.

methods.name: handleStartStructure
methods.description: Handles the start of a structure block, pushing a new structure onto the stack.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a structure block, popping from the stack and processing the structure.

methods.name: processField
methods.description: Parses a line into a configuration field and adds it to the current structure.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Generates a comment string with offset information.

methods.name: packComment
methods.description: Formats multi-line comments with a prefix.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a variable or parses an integer from a string.

methods.name: processDefine
methods.description: Processes a #define line and registers the macro.
